line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Real common thread bridge and cleanup under x86; no physical floppy hardware exercised.

decision: R1210/1225/1226 retain the typed FDC thread entry. x86 product object defines _fdc_thread (cdecl), calling the common void/cdecl parameter bridge. Original LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE cast promises DWORD WINAPI; it changes neither the stack cleanup nor void return of the callback. Changing fdc_thread declaration and definition alone would also leave the session enter/finish boundary unresolved. Keep original callback and shared bridge.
